# Open Conduct

> Open Conduct is the public standard behind the proposed Conduct Quotient. It documents the components, protections, decisions, evidence, open questions, and path to research. Version 0.5 is a developed proposal, not an operating standard or certified system.

## Current standard

- [Conduct Quotient 0.5](https://openconduct.org/standard/0.5/conduct-quotient): How qualifying Net Conduct Score and Verified Conduct Index inputs could produce one private contextual score.
- [Components](https://openconduct.org/components): How Net Conduct Score, Verified Conduct Index, and Conduct Quotient work together as the human, record-based, and contextual parts of the Open Conduct proposal.
- [Net Conduct Score](https://openconduct.org/netconductscore): The proposed open measure of human experience in an eligible, verified interaction.
- [Net Conduct Score specification 0.5](https://openconduct.org/standard/0.5/net-conduct-score): The normative requirements for capturing, aggregating, and protecting the human-experience input.
- [Verified Conduct Index 0.5](https://openconduct.org/standard/0.5/verified-conduct-index): The approved-record input for eligible responsibilities within a customer's control.
- [Verified Conduct Index overview](https://openconduct.org/verifiedconductindex): A plain-language explainer for the business-record input, including eligibility gates, exclusions, customer rights, and open questions.
- [The case for a standard](https://openconduct.org/case-for-conduct): Why customer conduct needs a shared standard rather than a private company feature, what a participating business might get, what a reward is allowed to be, and what survives if portability never clears review.
- [Protections and prohibited uses](https://openconduct.org/protections): Required limits, rights, remedies, and uses the proposal rejects.
- [Regulatory posture](https://openconduct.org/regulatory-posture): Which law each design decision is answering, which questions remain unresolved, and the legal work required before any pilot. Issue-spotting, not legal advice.

## Project record

- [Research and decisions](https://openconduct.org/library): The current specification, decision register, open questions, adversarial review, and synthetic research.
- [Download the complete v0.5 public record](https://openconduct.org/downloads/open-conduct-v0.5-public-record.zip): The versioned specification, decisions, open questions, architecture records, adversarial audit, and synthetic research Suites A–L, with checksums.
- [Status and governance](https://openconduct.org/status): What exists, what does not, and who stewards the work today.
- [Contribute](https://openconduct.org/contribute): How to challenge or improve the proposal.
- [Historical Conduct Quotient 0.4](https://openconduct.org/standard/0.4/conduct-quotient): Superseded historical proposal; excluded from search indexing.
